summary.zh-CN: 后台结果现在会主动回到你身边：其他会话完成时即时提醒，重要报告则进入可持久管理的收件箱。
summary.en-US: Background results now return to you through completion notifications and a persistent inbox for important reports.

body.zh-CN: 其他会话里的 AI 最终回复完成后，右上角会显示带有会话标题和纯文本摘要的可点击通知。
body.en-US: A completed final AI reply in another conversation produces a clickable upper-right notification with the conversation title and a plain-text preview.

body.zh-CN: 定时任务、后台 Agent 和长期监测可以把 Markdown 或静态 HTML 报告送到可持久管理的收件箱。
body.en-US: Scheduled work, background Agents, and long-running monitors can deliver Markdown or static HTML reports to a persistent inbox.

body.zh-CN: 在未读、全部和已归档视图中标记已读或未读、归档、恢复和删除送达内容。
body.en-US: Manage deliveries across Unread, All, and Archived views with read, unread, archive, restore, and delete actions.

body.zh-CN: 从送达内容创建或复用关联会话，并把完整报告作为 AI 上下文继续处理。
body.en-US: Create or reuse a linked conversation and continue with the complete delivered report supplied as AI context.

title.zh-CN: 更自然的未读默认行为

body.zh-CN: 有未读内容时优先展示未读，没有未读内容时自动展示全部历史记录。
body.en-US: The inbox prioritizes unread deliveries when present and otherwise falls back to the complete history.

body.zh-CN: 通知预览会清理 Markdown 标记，同时保留原始会话回复。
body.en-US: Notification previews remove Markdown syntax while preserving the original conversation response.

title.zh-CN: 静态 HTML 安全边界

body.zh-CN: HTML 报告支持内联样式，但脚本、表单、弹窗、远程资源和网络请求默认被隔离。
body.en-US: HTML reports support inline styles while scripts, forms, popups, remote resources, and network requests remain isolated by default.

body.zh-CN: 现有配置、会话和文件保持兼容，已有 NPM 安装可以通过 stable 通道升级。
body.en-US: Existing configuration, conversations, and files remain compatible, and npm installations can update through the stable channel.

body.zh-CN: NextClaw Desktop 0.0.237 为 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 打包 runtime 0.28.0，最低 launcher 版本保持 0.0.141。
body.en-US: NextClaw Desktop 0.0.237 packages runtime 0.28.0 for macOS, Windows, and Linux while keeping the minimum launcher version at 0.0.141.
